_comment: A named person threatened this child with a weapon for tomorrow. The classifier's job is only to return the category; the words the child then sees come from content/safety_messages.json, written by a person.
_provenance_note: Captured from Token Factory by tests/record_fixtures.py. 1 calls; token counts are the ones Nebius billed.
scenario: a real threat is classified as danger
text: He said he will bring a knife tomorrow and wait for me.

safety.because: The child reports an explicit future threat involving a weapon (a knife) and intent to cause physical harm ('wait for me'), which constitutes imminent danger.
